Hi Marta —

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting the vendor registration so Elmbridge can issue POs and route payments to Redwood Inference. Two quick asks to make your upload into the vendor portal go smoothly:

1) I've attached a vendor_portal_sample.csv with the columns we usually provide (legal_name, remit_name, tax_id, remit_iban, remit_swift, contact_email, currency, billing_address). Can you confirm whether Elmbridge requires any extra columns (vendor_group, tax_profile_code, or payment_terms_id)?

2) Do you require a signed W-9 via DocuSign, or is a PDF scan acceptable for US vendors? I've attached a stub redwood_W9_stub.pdf — we'll upload the final once you confirm preferred intake method and DocuSign sender.

A couple of clarifications on the PO flow so your AP team gets the invoices matched correctly:
- We always include Elmbridge PO number on the invoice header and reference lines.
- For multi-entity billing (Redwood Inference & Redwood Labs LLC) we can supply a single remit bank per legal entity; please tell us how you want us to represent the legal_entity_code in the portal.
- If Elmbridge has a PO acknowledgement step, can you confirm whether you expect a YES/NO ack or a line-level acceptance? We can provide a CSV of PO-ack responses if that helps automate matching.

Attachments: vendor_portal_sample.csv (CSV stub), redwood_W9_stub.pdf (W-9 stub)

If it helps, loop in your ap@elmbridge.com address and we'll work directly with them.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks, that helps. Quick answers from Elmbridge AP:
- Preferred intake: DocuSign for W-9s is preferred because our portal validates the signature metadata. A PDF scan is acceptable only for legacy uploads.
- Required columns: vendor_group and payment_terms_id are required for our upload. Also we use vendor_type to identify whether a supplier is Goods/Services/Software.
- PO acknowledgement: we prefer line-level acceptance but will accept a single acceptance flag if you cannot provide line-level. We can map either to our internal field po_ack_type.

I've attached Elmbridge_vendor_requirements.pdf which has the portal's column list and an example upload. Please note our system requires bank details as IBAN for EUR and BIC/Swift for USD wiring.

One more thing — can you confirm Redwood's legal entity name (exact registered name) and EIN so we can ensure tax withholding is set correctly? Also, we need to know whether Redwood will accept Elmbridge's standard 60-day net terms or prefers 30.
